We need count of methyl groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly need to retrieve NMR spectra to infer? But we need the structure. Maybe the sample is implicit? Could be previous tasks? No context. We may need to request proton NMR to see methyl signals? But counting methyl groups from NMR may be ambiguous. However we can get 1H NMR and count distinct methyl peaks (singlets, doublets, etc). But we need number of methyl groups, not signals. Could be overlapping.

Better to get carbon NMR and count signals around 10-30 ppm typical for methyl carbons. But need to know distinct methyl carbons.

We can request carbon NMR spectra. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool.
